name: Quantum chemistry relaxation benchmark (MLIPs)
description: An evaluation dataset and protocol for testing machine learning interatomic potentials on geometry relaxations and energy predictions in quantum chemistry.
evaluation_method: Energy and force MAE/RMSE (e.g., MAE in eV/atom and eV/Å), and geometry-relaxation success/convergence rate (task_success_rate for relaxations)
general_score_metric: Energy MAE (eV/atom) and force MAE (eV/Å), plus relaxation success rate
typical_sota_score: energy MAE ≈ 0.001–0.01 eV/atom; force MAE ≈ 0.01–0.1 eV/Å (ranges depend on system complexity and reference DFT settings)
reputation: Well-regarded within the machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) community as a realistic benchmark for relaxation and energy/force prediction performance.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on regression/physics tasks. Results are sensitive to the reference electronic-structure method, training data coverage, and convergence criteria. Potential for contamination if models were trained on the same DFT data; dataset size and chemical diversity vary across releases.
